data_staging_reason: The OSM candidate snapshot is retained, but the original A40 ZIP, PLATEAU raw catalog, official facility document bytes, inland-flood source, and storm-surge source are not all retained and trust-bound.
plateau_metadata_reason: Official delivery URLs are recorded, but the raw catalog bytes and corridor runtime coverage are not retained and independently verified in this recovery lane.
geometry_connection_reason: A bounded OSM VGI candidate dataset is hash-bound, but no renderer or reviewed route graph consumes it. The A40 derivative is preview-only until original ZIP trust, CRS transformation, license, and coverage are independently verified.
model_connection_reason: No candidate edge has verified static clear width, adjacent building height/setback, damage state, or debris-presence evidence required for M7.
plateau_connection_reason: Official 2025 building, bridge, and transportation delivery URLs are recorded as unbound metadata; raw catalog bytes, Cesium loading, CORS, and corridor coverage are not verified in this lane.

physically_reachable.reason: Candidate topology lacks verified entrances and M6 profile evaluation.

accommodated.reason: Traceable demand, current usable capacity, and facility operation are unavailable.

overflow_waiting.reason: Traceable demand, current usable capacity, and facility operation are unavailable.

unreachable.reason: Traceable demand origins and M6 profile evaluation are unavailable.

unknown_affected_upper_bound.reason: Traceable demand is unavailable; hazard overlap is not converted to closure or passability.
